description.text: The first of the two Gym sets, released on 14 August 2000 with 132 cards and a theme deck for each of the Gym Leaders it follows: Brock, Misty, Lt. Surge and Erika. It brought in Owner's Pokémon, belonging to Kanto's Gym Leaders, which evolve only from Pokémon of the same owner, and Stadium cards, and it was the first set since Base Set with all six basic Energy cards. Most of its art is by Ken Sugimori, and some of its Basic Pokémon are rares because in Japan they came only in theme decks.
